Why rent instead of buy

A portfolio rarely needs a robot in every building at once. Renting lets you move a serviced unit to where the work is, with no capital locked up and no maintenance burden — we handle repairs and the backup.

What we've seen work

The most common robot use case in property management

The two use cases that come up most often for property managers are overnight floor cleaning in lobbies and common corridors, and delivery robots for amenity runs — packages, dry cleaning, or food orders moving from the front desk or a receiving room up to residents. In both cases the economics work because the robot covers a route the building runs every day, and the rental model means you are not holding hardware in a building where the work is light.

For a portfolio with mixed building types and floor plans, the common starting point is one pilot unit in the highest-traffic property. We handle the deployment, map the routes, and train the building staff. If the pilot works, scaling to other properties in the portfolio is straightforward — the same unit type, the same rental model, moved or replicated as needed.

Customers in property management typically recover deployment cost within the first several months through reduced contract cleaning hours and labor savings on amenity runs.

Talk to us about your site

Which robot fits your property management operation?

Three questions to narrow it down. Answer yes or no — we will tell you where it leads.

Question 1

Does your building have large common-area floors — lobby, corridors, or amenity spaces — that get cleaned on a regular schedule?

Yes

A Gausium Scrubber is the right starting point. It handles sealed concrete, tile, vinyl, and polished stone floors overnight or alongside staff, on a schedule you set.

No

Next: Do you need to move packages, dry cleaning, or amenity items from the front desk or a receiving room to residents?

Question 2

Do you need to move packages, dry cleaning, or amenity items from the front desk or a receiving room to residents?

Yes

A delivery robot handles point-to-point amenity runs inside the building. We map the route and configure elevator handoffs during deployment.

No — I'm not sure what the right fit is yet

Tell us about your facility and we will recommend the right starting point.

Common questions

Can I use one rental across several buildings?
Yes. You rent the unit and put it where the work is. We deploy it, service it, and keep a backup, so a portfolio does not need a machine sitting in every building.
What floors can a cleaning robot handle?
The cleaning robots we rent scrub, sweep, and vacuum large commercial floors — lobbies, corridors, and amenity spaces. We match the unit to your surface and layout on a walkthrough.
Is maintenance included?
Yes. Service, repairs, and a backup unit are part of every rental.
